title: The AI Wrote This Code. Is It Right?
subject: Computer science
blurb: A chatbot wrote code to average test scores and said it works. Does it?
intro: A student asked an AI chatbot to write code that finds the average of some test scores. Here is what the AI gave back.

chart.alt: A diagram tracing the code. The counter starts at 1, so the first score is never added, but the code still divides by all three scores.

regions.caption: the part where the counter starts at 1 instead of 0
the first score, 80, which never gets added to the total
the divide step, which still divides by all 3 scores
the note that an empty list would make the code crash

transcript.text: Student: I asked the AI for the code and it answered right away.
Student: It said the code was correct, so I did not really check it.
Student: I tested it one time and it printed a number.
Teacher: What should the average of 80, 90, and 100 be?

opening_prompt: The AI says this code is correct. What is one thing you would check before you trust it? You can highlight a line of the code or click part of the diagram.
